title: Media, reklama va yangiliklar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida media lug‘atini to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, reklamani bir daqiqada tahlil qilasiz (auditoriya, xabar, usullar, baho), manbaning xolisligini baholaysiz va yangilikni xabar fe’llari bilan aniq yetkazasiz.

scenes.title: Media, reklama va yangiliklar
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda taxmin va ehtimollikni ifodaladik: must have, might have, can’t have. Bugun ular yana kerak bo‘ladi, chunki mavzu media, reklama va yangiliklar. Dars oxirida media lug‘atini erkin ishlatasiz, reklamani bir daqiqada tahlil qilasiz, manba ishonchliligini baholaysiz va yangilikni aniq yetkazasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we're talking about the media: news, adverts, and how to tell whether a source can be trusted.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun media haqida gaplashamiz: yangiliklar, reklamalar va manbaga ishonish mumkinmi, yo‘qmi.

scenes.title: Media turlari va kasblar

examples.t: The story was covered by every major outlet.
examples.uz: Bu voqeani barcha yirik nashrlar yoritdi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: media lug‘ati. “The media” gazeta, televideniye, radio va internetni birga bildiradi, odatda “the” bilan. Muayyan gazeta yoki kanal “a news outlet”. “Reporter” xabar yig‘adi, “correspondent” boshqa shahar yoki davlatdagi muxbir, “editor” nima chop etilishini hal qiladi. “Headline” sarlavha, “coverage” voqeaning qanchalik yoritilgani.
scenes.say: The media covers print, broadcast and online. A single paper or channel is an outlet. Reporters gather stories; editors decide what's published.
scenes.say_uz: Media bosma, efir va onlayn vositalarni qamraydi. Bitta gazeta yoki kanal outlet. Reporter xabar yig‘adi, editor nima chop etilishini hal qiladi.

scenes.title: Media birikmalari
board: break a story (birinchi bo‘lib xabar bermoq)
go viral (tez tarqalmoq) · cover a story

examples.uz: Video bir kechada tez tarqalib ketdi.

examples.t: A local paper broke the story.
examples.uz: Voqeani birinchi bo‘lib mahalliy gazeta e’lon qildi.

scenes.say_native: B2 darajada alohida so‘zdan ko‘ra birikma muhim. “Hit the headlines”, ya’ni hamma gapira boshlagan xabar. “Break a story”, birinchi bo‘lib xabar berish. “Go viral”, internetda tez tarqalish, o‘tgan zamoni “went viral”. O‘zbekchada “xabar tarqatdi” deymiz, lekin inglizchada “spread a story” emas, “break a story” aniq ma’no beradi.
scenes.say: A story hits the headlines, a journalist breaks a story, a video goes viral, and a channel covers an event.
scenes.say_uz: Xabar sarlavhalarga chiqadi, jurnalist uni birinchi e’lon qiladi, video tez tarqaladi, kanal voqeani yoritadi.

scenes.title: News: sanalmaydigan ot
board: a piece of news / some news
on the internet · on TV · in the paper

examples.t: I've got some good news for you.

scenes.say_native: “News” oxirida “s” bor, lekin bu ko‘plik emas. U sanalmaydi: “the news is”, “a news” demaymiz. Bitta xabar “a piece of news” yoki “some news”. O‘zbekchada “yangiliklar” ko‘plikda, shu sabab xato ko‘p. Predloglar: “on the internet”, “on TV”, “on the radio”, lekin gazeta uchun “in the paper”.
scenes.say: News looks plural but it's uncountable: the news is depressing. Say a piece of news. On TV, on the internet, but in the paper.
scenes.say_uz: News sanalmaydi: the news is. A piece of news deymiz. On TV, on the internet, lekin in the paper.

scenes.title: Media mavzusidagi xatolar
board: ✗ The news are bad. → ✓ The news is bad.
✗ I saw it in internet. → ✓ on the internet
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, “the news are”, to‘g‘risi “the news is”. Ikkinchisi, “in internet”: to‘g‘risi “on the internet”, artikl bilan. Uchinchisi, “advertising” sanalmaydi va sohani bildiradi: “I work in advertising.” Bitta reklama esa “an advert”, qisqasi “an ad”, televideniye yoki radioda “a commercial”.
scenes.say: Advertising is the industry and it's uncountable. One example is an advert, an ad, or on TV, a commercial.
scenes.say_uz: Advertising soha, sanalmaydi. Bitta reklama an advert, an ad yoki televizorda commercial.

scenes.title: Bo‘shliqlarni to‘ldiring
board: 3 I saw a funny ___ on TV.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz sinab ko‘ring. To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida “be” ning hozirgi zamon shakli. Ikkinchisida “hit” ning o‘tgan zamoni. Uchinchisida televizordagi bitta reklama uchun so‘z. To‘rtinchisida predlog. Pauzada javoblarni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Complete the four sentences. Say your answers aloud.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt gapni to‘ldiring. Javoblarni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The news is shocking”, birlik. Ikkinchi: “hit” noto‘g‘ri fe’l, uchala shakli bir xil: hit, hit, hit. Demak “The story hit the headlines.” Uchinchi: “a commercial” yoki “an advert”, ikkalasi to‘g‘ri. To‘rtinchi: “She works in advertising”, soha oldidan “in”, xuddi “in banking” kabi.
scenes.say: The news is shocking. The story hit the headlines. A commercial. She works in advertising.
scenes.say_uz: The news is shocking. The story hit the headlines. A commercial. She works in advertising.

scenes.title: Reklama lug‘ati

examples.t: The trainers are endorsed by a famous footballer.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: reklamani tahlil qilish. Avval so‘zlar. “Brand” mahsulot nomi va obrazi, “slogan” esda qoladigan shior, “campaign” bir necha reklamadan iborat kampaniya. “Target audience” reklama kimga mo‘ljallangani. Mashhur odam mahsulotni ma’qullasa, “endorse” deymiz, bu “celebrity endorsement”.
scenes.say: Key words: a brand, a slogan, a campaign, a target audience. When a celebrity promotes a product, they endorse it.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy so‘zlar: brand, slogan, campaign, target audience. Mashhur odam mahsulotni targ‘ib qilsa, endorse deyiladi.

scenes.title: Tahlil rejasi
scenes.say_native: Har qanday reklama uchun to‘rt savolli reja bor. Birinchi, kimga qaratilgan: yosh, turmush tarzi. Ikkinchi, asosiy xabar nima: mahsulot hayotingizni qanday o‘zgartiradi deyilmoqda. Uchinchi, qanday usullar ishlatilgan. To‘rtinchi, u samaralimi va nega. Shu tartibda gapirsangiz, tahlil mantiqli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Ask: who is it aimed at? What's the message? What techniques does it use? Does it work, and why?
scenes.say_uz: So‘rang: kimga qaratilgan? Xabar nima? Qanday usullar bor? Ishlaydimi, nega?

scenes.title: Ishontirish usullari
scenes.say_native: Reklamachilar bir necha usuldan foydalanadi. “Emotional appeal”, qo‘rquv yoki baxt hissiga murojaat. Mashhur odamning tavsiyasi. Hazil. “Bandwagon”: hamma sotib olyapti, siz ham qo‘shiling. Shoshilinchlik: “Only today!” Va ilmiy ko‘rinadigan raqamlar. Usullarning nomini bilsangiz, tahlil professional eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Common techniques: emotional appeal, celebrity endorsement, humour, the bandwagon effect, urgency, and impressive statistics.
scenes.say_uz: Usullar: hissiyotga murojaat, mashhur odam, hazil, hamma sotib olyapti effekti, shoshilinchlik va ta’sirli raqamlar.

scenes.title: Tinglang: radio reklamasi
scenes.say_native: Endi qisqa radio reklamasini tinglang. Bu o‘ylab topilgan mahsulot, ZestUp nomli energetik ichimlik. Tinglayotganda o‘zingizdan so‘rang: reklama kimga qaratilgan va qaysi usullar ishlatilgan? Kamida uchta usulni topishga harakat qiling, keyin savollar beraman.
scenes.say: Exams tomorrow? Deadline tonight? Don't let tiredness win. ZestUp gives you the energy to keep going. Champion sprinter Maya Cole says: I never train without it. Join the two million students who already love ZestUp. This week only, two cans for the price of one!
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga imtihonmi? Bugun muddatmi? Charchoqqa yutqazmang. ZestUp kuch beradi. Chempion yuguruvchi Maya Koul: usiz hech qachon mashq qilmayman. ZestUp ni sevgan ikki million talabaga qo‘shiling. Faqat shu hafta ikki banka bitta narxida!

scenes.title: Reklamani tahlil qiling
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi, reklama kimga mo‘ljallangan? Kalit so‘zlarni eslang. Ikkinchi, uchta ishontirish usulini inglizcha atama bilan nomlang. Uchinchi, “this week only” tinglovchida qanday his uyg‘otadi? To‘liq gap bilan, ovoz chiqarib javob bering.
scenes.say: Who is it aimed at? Name three techniques. What does this week only create?
scenes.say_uz: Kimga qaratilgan? Uch usulni ayting. This week only nima yaratadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: imtihon va muddat bosimidagi talabalar, buni “exams” va “deadline” ko‘rsatadi. Ikkinchi: chempion sportchi, ya’ni celebrity endorsement; ikki million talaba, ya’ni bandwagon; charchoq qo‘rquvi, emotional appeal. Uchinchi: “this week only” shoshilinchlik yaratadi, odam o‘ylamasdan tez sotib olishga undaladi.
scenes.say: It targets stressed students. It uses a celebrity, the bandwagon effect and fear of failure. This week only creates urgency.
scenes.say_uz: Stressdagi talabalarga qaratilgan. Mashhur odam, bandwagon va muvaffaqiyatsizlik qo‘rquvi bor. This week only shoshilinchlik yaratadi.

scenes.title: Tahlil tili
board: It is aimed at… / It targets…
It appeals to… / It plays on…
It relies on… · The slogan suggests that…

examples.t: It plays on parents' worries about safety.
examples.uz: U ota-onalarning xavfsizlik haqidagi xavotiridan foydalanadi.

scenes.say_native: Tahlil uchun tayyor iboralar. “It is aimed at young professionals”, yosh mutaxassislarga qaratilgan. “It appeals to our desire for status”, mavqega intilishimizga murojaat qiladi. “It plays on our fears”, biroz salbiy: qo‘rquvimizdan foydalanadi. “It relies on humour”, hazilga tayanadi. Xulosa uchun: “What makes it effective is…”.
scenes.say: Useful phrases: it's aimed at, it appeals to, it plays on, it relies on, and what makes it effective is.
scenes.say_uz: Foydali iboralar: aimed at, appeals to, plays on, relies on va what makes it effective is.

scenes.title: Baholash va taxmin
board: It might be designed to… · They must be hoping…
scenes.say_native: Tahlil baholashni ham talab qiladi. Ijobiy: “clever”, “memorable”, “eye-catching”. Salbiy: “misleading”, chalg‘ituvchi, yoki “it falls flat”, ta’sir qilmaydi. Reklamachining niyatini aniq bilmaymiz, shuning uchun oldingi darsdagi modallar qo‘l keladi: “It might be designed to…”, “They must be hoping to…”.
scenes.say: Evaluate, too. Is it clever, memorable or misleading? Speculate: they must be hoping to look modern.
scenes.say_uz: Baholang: aqlli, esda qoladigan yoki chalg‘ituvchi? Taxmin qiling: ular zamonaviy ko‘rinishni umid qilayotgan bo‘lsa kerak.

scenes.title: Tahlildagi xatolar
board: ✗ aimed to young people → ✓ aimed at
✗ makes people to buy → ✓ makes people buy
✗ The advert want… → ✓ The advert tries to…
scenes.say_native: Uchta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi, “aimed to young people”, to‘g‘risi “aimed at”. Ikkinchisi, “makes people to buy”: “make” dan keyin “to” qo‘yilmaydi, “makes people buy”. Uchinchisi, “the advert want”, uchinchi shaxs “s” siz. Yaxshisi “The advert tries to show” yoki “is designed to show”.
scenes.say: Aimed at, not aimed to. Make someone do, with no to. And try: the advert is designed to show.
scenes.say_uz: Aimed to emas, aimed at. Make dan keyin to yo‘q. The advert is designed to show deng.

scenes.title: Reklamani tasvirlang
board: Advert: a smiling family in a new car on a mountain road
scenes.say_native: Gapirish mashqi. Reklamada baxtli oila yangi mashinada tog‘ yo‘lida ketmoqda. Shiori: “Go further together”. Uchta gap ayting: kimga qaratilgan, qaysi usul ishlatilgan va sizningcha samaralimi, nega. Hozir o‘rgangan iboralardan kamida ikkitasini ishlating.
scenes.say: A smiling family drives a new car along a mountain road. Slogan: Go further together. Say three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Baxtli oila yangi mashinada tog‘ yo‘lida. Shior: Go further together. Uchta gap ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: It's aimed at families with young children.
It appeals to our desire for adventure and closeness.
What makes it effective is the slogan.
scenes.say_native: Namunaga e’tibor bering: har gapda bitta tahlil iborasi bor, oxirida esa “which” bilan qo‘shimcha fikr. Avval auditoriya, keyin usul, oxirida baho. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi shu tuzilma. Agar iboralardan ikkitasini ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi natija.
scenes.say: It's aimed at families with young children. It appeals to our desire for adventure and closeness. What makes it effective is the slogan, which links the car to family unity.
scenes.say_uz: U yosh bolali oilalarga qaratilgan. Sarguzasht va yaqinlikka intilishga murojaat qiladi. Uni samarali qiladigan narsa shior, u mashinani oila birligi bilan bog‘laydi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ikki do‘st reklama haqida
board: Listen: Aziz and Kate discuss an advert
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Aziz va Keyt internetda ko‘rgan reklama haqida gaplashmoqda va uni turlicha baholaydi. E’tibor bering: reklama nima haqida, Keytga nima yoqdi, Aziz esa nimadan shubhalanyapti. Oldingi darsdagi taxmin modallari ham uchraydi, ularni eshitishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Aziz: Have you seen that skincare ad with the famous actress? Kate: Yes! I almost bought the cream. Aziz: She must be paid a fortune to say that. Kate: But the before-and-after photos were convincing. Aziz: They might have been edited. And it says ninety per cent of women agree, but only fifty were asked. Kate: OK, it's misleading. Still memorable, though.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Mashhur aktrisa bilan teri kremi reklamasini ko‘rdingmi? Keyt: Ha! Kremni sotib olishimga oz qoldi. Aziz: Buni aytgani uchun unga katta pul to‘langan bo‘lsa kerak. Keyt: Lekin oldin va keyin suratlari ishonarli edi. Aziz: Ular tahrir qilingan bo‘lishi mumkin. Yana to‘qson foiz ayol rozi deyilgan, lekin faqat ellik kishidan so‘ralgan. Keyt: Mayli, chalg‘ituvchi. Lekin esda qoladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari
board: 2 Why does Aziz doubt the photos?
3 What is wrong with the statistic?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi, mahsulot nima? Ikkinchi, Aziz nega suratlarga ishonmaydi, qaysi modalni ishlatdi? Uchinchi, statistik raqamning muammosi nimada? To‘rtinchi, oxirida Keyt reklamani qanday baholaydi? Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni qayta eshiting va kalit so‘zlarni yozib oling.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi to‘rt savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: teri kremi. Ikkinchi: Aziz “they might have been edited” dedi, oldingi darsdagi “might have plus past participle”. Uchinchi: to‘qson foiz katta ko‘rinadi, lekin atigi ellik kishidan so‘ralgan, bu ishonchli namuna emas. To‘rtinchi: Keyt reklama chalg‘ituvchi, lekin esda qoladigan, deb tan oldi.
scenes.say: A skin cream. The photos might have been edited. The sample was tiny. Kate agrees it's misleading but memorable.
scenes.say_uz: Teri kremi. Suratlar tahrir qilingan bo‘lishi mumkin. Namuna juda kichik. Keyt chalg‘ituvchi, lekin esda qoladi, deydi.

scenes.title: Xolislik va ishonchlilik

examples.t: The report was clearly biased against the government.
examples.uz: Hisobot aniq hukumatga qarshi bir tomonlama edi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: xolislik va ishonchlilik. “Biased” bir tomonlama: “biased against” qarshi, “biased in favour of” tarafdor. Teskarisi “impartial” yoki “objective”. Ishonchli manba “a reliable source”. “Misinformation” noto‘g‘ri ma’lumot, ataylab bo‘lmasligi mumkin. “Disinformation” esa ataylab tarqatilgan yolg‘on. “Clickbait” bosish uchun yasalgan sarlavha.
scenes.say: Biased means one-sided. The opposite is impartial. Misinformation is simply false; disinformation is false on purpose.
scenes.say_uz: Biased bir tomonlama, teskarisi impartial. Misinformation shunchaki noto‘g‘ri, disinformation ataylab yolg‘on.

scenes.title: Manbani tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Manba ishonchlimi, qanday bilamiz? To‘rtta savol. Kim va qachon yozgan? Dalil va manbalar bormi? Boshqa nashrlar tasdiqlaydimi? Til qanday: bo‘rttirilgan, hissiyotli so‘zlar ko‘p bo‘lsa, ehtiyot bo‘ling. Bu jarayon inglizchada “fact-checking”, fe’li esa “to fact-check a story”.
scenes.say: Before you share a story, check the author, the date, the evidence, and whether other outlets confirm it. That's fact-checking.
scenes.say_uz: Ulashishdan oldin muallif, sana, dalil va boshqa nashrlar tasdiqlashini tekshiring. Bu fact-checking.

scenes.title: Yuklangan so‘zlar
scenes.say_native: Bir tomonlamalik ko‘pincha so‘z tanlovida yashirinadi, bunday so‘zlar “loaded words”. Bitta guruhni “protesters” ham, “rioters” ham deyish mumkin, ikkinchisi salbiy baho. “Said” neytral, “admitted” aybni tan olishni bildiradi. Narxlar “rose” yoki “skyrocketed”. O‘zbekchada ham shunday: “namoyishchi” va “to‘polonchi”.
scenes.say: Bias hides in word choice. Protesters is neutral; rioters judges. Said is neutral; admitted suggests guilt.
scenes.say_uz: Bir tomonlamalik so‘z tanlovida yashirinadi. Protesters neytral, rioters baho beradi. Admitted aybni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor xabar tili

examples.t: The minister allegedly accepted a bribe.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi jurnalist tasdiqlanmagan narsani fakt sifatida aytmaydi. “According to the police”, politsiya ma’lumotiga ko‘ra. “Reportedly”, xabar qilinishicha. “Allegedly”, go‘yoki: ayblov bor, lekin isbotlanmagan. Majhul nisbat ham: “It is claimed that…”. Bu so‘zlarni ko‘rsangiz, hali fakt emasligini tushunasiz.
scenes.say: Journalists mark claims carefully: according to, reportedly, allegedly, it is claimed that.
scenes.say_uz: Jurnalistlar da’voni belgilaydi: according to, reportedly, allegedly, it is claimed that.

scenes.title: Ishonchlilik xatolari
board: ✗ according to me → ✓ in my opinion
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. “Trustable” standart ingliz tilida deyarli ishlatilmaydi, “trustworthy” yoki “reliable” deng. “Biased to” emas, “biased towards” yoki “biased against”. Eng keng tarqalgani “according to me”. “According to” boshqa manbaga ishora qiladi, o‘z fikringiz uchun “in my opinion” yoki “in my view” deng.
scenes.say: Never say according to me. For your own view, say in my opinion.
scenes.say_uz: According to me demang. O‘z fikringiz uchun in my opinion deng.

scenes.title: Qaysi sarlavha xolis?
board: B: Greedy council slaps families with tax hike
Which is biased? Find two loaded words.
scenes.say_native: Ikki sarlavhani solishtiring. Ikkalasi bitta voqea haqida: kengash soliqni besh foizga oshirdi. Qaysi biri bir tomonlama? Unda ikkita yuklangan so‘zni toping va qanday taassurot berishini ayting. Javobni “Headline B is biased because…” bilan boshlashingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Which headline is biased? Find two loaded words.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi sarlavha bir tomonlama? Ikki yuklangan so‘zni toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: B sarlavha bir tomonlama. “Greedy”, ochko‘z, kengashga salbiy baho beradi. “Slaps families with” zo‘ravonlik va adolatsizlik taassurotini uyg‘otadi. “Hike” ham “rise” dan kuchliroq. A sarlavha neytral: “approves” va “rise” baho bermaydi. Faktlar bir xil, lekin B o‘quvchini g‘azablantirishga urinadi.
scenes.say: B is biased: greedy is a judgement, and slaps families with sounds aggressive. A simply reports the facts.
scenes.say_uz: B bir tomonlama: greedy baho beradi, slaps families with tajovuzkor eshitiladi. A faqat faktni beradi.

scenes.title: Yangilik tuzilishi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: yangilikni yetkazish. Inglizcha yangilik odatda teskari piramida, “inverted pyramid” tuzilishida. Eng muhimi birinchi gapda: nima, kim, qayerda, qachon. Keyin qanday va nega. Oxirida fon va iqtiboslar. O‘quvchi faqat birinchi gapni o‘qisa ham voqeani biladi.
scenes.say: News uses an inverted pyramid: what, who, where and when first, then how and why, then background.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilik teskari piramida: avval nima, kim, qayerda, qachon; keyin qanday va nega; oxirida fon.

scenes.title: Sarlavha grammatikasi
board: Present simple = recent past: 'Storm hits coast'
to + verb = future: 'PM to visit China'
scenes.say_native: Sarlavhalarning o‘z grammatikasi bor. Yaqinda bo‘lgan voqea uchun present simple: “Storm hits coast”, garchi bo‘ron allaqachon urilgan bo‘lsa ham. Kelajak uchun “to” plus fe’l: “PM to visit China”. Majhul nisbatda yordamchi fe’l tushadi: “Man arrested”, ya’ni “A man has been arrested”. Artikllar ham tushiriladi.
scenes.say: In headlines, the present simple reports recent events, to plus a verb means the future, and a past participle alone is passive.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhada present simple yaqin o‘tmish, to + fe’l kelajak, yolg‘iz past participle majhul nisbat.

scenes.title: Yangilikda zamonlar
board: Details with a time: past simple

examples.t: A fire has broken out in the city centre. It started at around 3 a.m.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida yong‘in chiqdi. U taxminan soat uchda boshlangan.

scenes.say_native: Radio yangiligi ko‘pincha present perfect bilan boshlanadi, chunki xabar yangi va hozir muhim: “A fire has broken out.” Aniq vaqt yoki tafsilot aytilishi bilan past simple ga o‘tamiz: “It started at around 3 a.m.” O‘zbek tilida bu farq yo‘q, ikkalasi ham “chiqdi”, shuning uchun o‘tishni ongli mashq qiling.
scenes.say: News opens with the present perfect: a fire has broken out. With a time, switch to the past simple: it started at three.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilik present perfect bilan ochiladi. Vaqt aytilganda past simple ga o‘tiladi.

scenes.title: Xabar fe’llari

examples.t: Police warned drivers not to travel.

scenes.say_native: Yangilikda “said” dan boshqa fe’llar ham kerak, har birining qolipi bor. “Announce” va “confirm” dan keyin “that”. “Deny” dan keyin “-ing”: “denied breaking the law”. “Warn” va “urge” dan keyin odam va “to”. “Claim” ikki qolip oladi: “claimed that he was innocent” yoki “claimed to be innocent”.
scenes.say: Announce and confirm take that. Deny takes an -ing form. Warn and urge take a person plus to.
scenes.say_uz: Announce, confirm + that; deny + -ing; warn, urge + odam + to.

scenes.title: Xabar qilishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ He denied to steal. → ✓ He denied stealing.
✗ She said me… → ✓ She told me… / said to me
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda xato ko‘p. “Denied to steal” emas, “denied stealing”. “Said me” ham noto‘g‘ri: “say” dan keyin odam to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri kelmaydi, “told me” yoki “said to me”. Xuddi shunday “explained me” emas, “explained to me”. O‘zbekchada “menga aytdi” deymiz, shuning uchun “me” ni darrov qo‘yib yuboramiz.
scenes.say: Tell someone, but say something to someone. She told me; she explained it to me.
scenes.say_uz: Tell + odam, lekin say va explain + to + odam: told me, explained it to me.

scenes.title: Sarlavhani oching
scenes.say_native: Uchta sarlavhani to‘liq gapga aylantiring. Artikllarni qaytaring va to‘g‘ri zamonni tanlang. Birinchisida “to” nimani bildiradi? Ikkinchisida majhul nisbat yashiringan. Uchinchisida present simple aslida yaqinda bo‘lgan voqea, demak present perfect kerak.
scenes.say: Turn the three headlines into full sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Uch sarlavhani to‘liq gapga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 The minister is going to resign.
2 A teenager has been rescued from a river.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The minister is going to resign”, iste’foga chiqmoqchi. Ikkinchi: “A teenager has been rescued from a river”, majhul nisbat va present perfect. Uchinchi: “Prices have risen again”. “Rise” noto‘g‘ri fe’l: rise, rose, risen. Sarlavhada qisqa shakl, to‘liq gapda esa butun grammatika qaytadi.
scenes.say: The minister is going to resign. A teenager has been rescued. Prices have risen again.
scenes.say_uz: Vazir iste’foga chiqmoqchi. O‘smir qutqarildi. Narxlar yana oshdi.

scenes.title: Xabar fe’li bilan ayting
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri gaplarni xabar fe’li bilan qayta ayting. Birinchisi kompaniya so‘zi, “deny” bilan. Ikkinchisi politsiya ogohlantirishi, “warn” bilan, kimni ogohlantirganini qo‘shing. Uchinchisi kengash e’loni, “announce” bilan, zamonni bir qadam orqaga suring. Qoliplarni eslang.
scenes.say: Report each sentence with the verb in brackets.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qavsdagi fe’l bilan yetkazing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 The company denied hiding the data.
2 Police warned people not to swim in the lake.
3 The council announced that the bridge would open in May.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The company denied hiding the data.” “Didn’t” yo‘qoldi, chunki “deny” o‘zi inkor ma’nosini beradi. Ikkinchi: “Police warned people not to swim in the lake”, inkor “not to” shaklida. Uchinchi: “The council announced that the bridge would open in May.” Ko‘prik hali ochilmagan bo‘lsa, “will open” ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: The company denied hiding the data. Police warned people not to swim. The council announced that the bridge would open in May.
scenes.say_uz: Kompaniya rad etdi. Politsiya suzmaslikni ogohlantirdi. Kengash ko‘prik mayda ochilishini e’lon qildi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: yangiliklar studiyasi
board: Listen: a presenter and a reporter
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: radio yangiliklari, boshlovchi voqea joyidagi muxbir bilan gaplashmoqda. Teskari piramidaga, zamonlar almashinuviga va ehtiyotkor so‘zlarga e’tibor bering. Nima bo‘ldi, qachon, va nima hali tasdiqlanmagan? Diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin savollar bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Presenter: Breaking news: a fire has broken out at a shopping centre in Leeds. Our reporter Sam is there. Sam: Yes, the fire started just after six this morning. According to the fire service, everyone was evacuated safely. Presenter: Do we know the cause? Sam: Not yet. Witnesses claim they heard an explosion, but that hasn't been confirmed. Police have urged people to avoid the area.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Shoshilinch xabar: Lidsdagi savdo markazida yong‘in chiqdi. Muxbirimiz Sem u yerda. Sem: Ha, yong‘in ertalab soat oltidan keyin boshlandi. O‘t o‘chirish xizmatiga ko‘ra, hamma xavfsiz chiqarilgan. Boshlovchi: Sababi ma’lummi? Sem: Hali yo‘q. Guvohlar portlash eshitganini da’vo qilmoqda, lekin bu tasdiqlanmagan. Politsiya odamlarni hududdan uzoq yurishga chaqirdi.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari
board: 1 Where and when did the fire start?
2 Was anyone hurt? Who says so?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Yong‘in qayerda va qachon boshlandi? Kimdir jarohatlandimi va bu ma’lumot kimdan? Qaysi ma’lumot hali tasdiqlanmagan? Politsiya odamlarni nimaga chaqirdi? Javobda “according to” va xabar fe’llaridan foydalaning, to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi to‘rt savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 a shopping centre in Leeds, just after 6 a.m.
2 No — according to the fire service
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Lidsdagi savdo markazida, soat oltidan keyin. Birinchi gap “has broken out”, vaqt aytilganda esa “started”. Ikkinchi: yo‘q, o‘t o‘chirish xizmatiga ko‘ra hamma xavfsiz. Uchinchi: portlash, buni faqat guvohlar da’vo qilmoqda. To‘rtinchi: “urged people to avoid the area”.
scenes.say: In Leeds, just after six. No one was hurt, according to the fire service. The explosion is only a claim.
scenes.say_uz: Lidsda, soat oltidan keyin. Hech kim jarohatlanmagan. Portlash faqat da’vo.

scenes.title: Talaffuz va zaif shakllar
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. “Advert” va “advertise” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Advertisement” da Britaniyada ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: adVERtisement, Amerikada esa adverTISEment. “News” oxirida “z” tovushi. Diktorlar tez gapiradi, kichik so‘zlar zaiflashadi: “according to the” da “to” qisqa “tə” bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Advert, advertise, advertisement. In American English: advertisement. News ends in a z sound. According to the.
scenes.say_uz: Advert, advertise, advertisement. Amerikacha: advertisement. News z bilan tugaydi. According to the.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: bir daqiqalik tahlil
board: aimed at · appeals to · might be designed to
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. O‘zingiz biladigan bitta reklamani tanlang. Bir daqiqa davomida tahlil qiling: kimga qaratilgan, asosiy xabar, kamida ikkita usul va bahoingiz. Kamida bitta taxmin modalini ishlating. Taymerni qo‘yib, ovoz chiqarib gapiring. To‘xtab qolsangiz, rejaga qayting.
scenes.say: Choose an advert you know. Analyse it for one minute.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz biladigan reklamani tanlang. Bir daqiqa tahlil qiling.

scenes.title: Namuna tahlil
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Tartibga, tahlil iboralariga va bitta taxmin modaliga e’tibor bering. Bog‘lovchilar ham bor: “firstly”, “what’s more”, “overall”. Sizning reklamangiz boshqa, lekin shu skeletni ishlating. Ikki-uch marta takrorlasangiz, bir daqiqa juda tez o‘tadi.
scenes.say: This phone advert is aimed at young professionals. Its message is that the phone makes you creative. Firstly, it relies on stunning images. What's more, a famous photographer endorses it. They must be hoping to look premium. Overall, it's eye-catching but slightly misleading.
scenes.say_uz: Bu telefon reklamasi yosh mutaxassislarga qaratilgan. Xabari: telefon sizni ijodkor qiladi. Birinchidan, ajoyib tasvirlarga tayanadi. Bundan tashqari, mashhur fotograf uni tavsiya qiladi. Ular qimmat ko‘rinishni umid qilayotgan bo‘lsa kerak. Umuman, ko‘zga tashlanadi, lekin biroz chalg‘ituvchi.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: the news is · on the internet · an advert
aimed at · appeals to · plays on
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Media lug‘ati: “the news is”, “on the internet”, “an advert” va “advertising”, “hit the headlines”, “go viral”. Reklama tahlili: auditoriya, xabar, usullar, baho. Ishonchlilik: “biased”, “reliable”, yuklangan so‘zlar, “allegedly”. Yangilik: teskari piramida, sarlavha grammatikasi, zamonlar va xabar fe’llari.
scenes.say: Today: media collocations, analysing adverts, spotting bias, and reporting the news.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun: media birikmalari, reklama tahlili, bir tomonlamalikni aniqlash va yangilik yetkazish.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: analyse an advert in 1 minute
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bitta reklamani bir daqiqada ingliz tilida tahlil qilib, ovozingizni yozib oling. Mezon: auditoriya, xabar, kamida ikkita nomlangan usul, asosli baho va bugungi uchta ibora. Yozuvni qayta tinglab, “news is” va “aimed at” kabi joylarni tekshiring. Keyingi darsda madaniyatlararo farqlarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Analyse one advert in one minute and record it. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Bitta reklamani bir daqiqada tahlil qilib, yozib oling. Keyingi safar ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Bitta reklamani tanlab, uni ingliz tilida bir daqiqada tahlil qiling va ovozingizni yozib oling. Mezon: auditoriya, asosiy xabar, kamida ikkita nomlangan ishontirish usuli, asosli baho va kamida uchta darsdagi ibora (masalan, aimed at, appeals to, might be designed to).

options: The news are very bad today.
The news is very bad today.
A news is very bad today.
The newses are very bad today.
quiz.why_uz: News sanalmaydigan ot, birlikda: the news is.

quiz.q: I saw the advert ___ the internet.
quiz.why_uz: Internet bilan on ishlatiladi: on the internet.

options: The advert makes people to feel guilty.
The advert makes people feel guilty.
The advert makes people feeling guilty.
The advert make people feel guilty.
quiz.why_uz: Make + odam + fe’l, to siz; advert birlikda, makes.

options: an honest mistake in a report
quiz.why_uz: Disinformation ataylab tarqatilgan yolg‘on; misinformation esa ataylab bo‘lmasligi mumkin.

quiz.q: Which word is the most neutral?
quiz.why_uz: Protesters baho bermaydi, qolganlari salbiy yuklangan so‘zlar.

quiz.q: Headline: 'President to visit Tashkent'. This means the president…

options: She said me the story was false.
She told me the story was false.
She explained me the story was false.
She told to me the story was false.
quiz.why_uz: Tell + odam: told me. Say va explain dan keyin to kerak.

quiz.q: Where is the stress in British 'advertisement'?
